name: Villanueva's Professional Services (tax / notary)
what_they_do: Bilingual (Spanish-first) professional services office offering tax preparation and planning, IRS/NJ problem resolution, notary public services, document translation, help with forms, money transfers and (through a sister brand) a driving school. Two branches, Trenton and New Brunswick.
customers: Spanish-speaking individuals, families and small business owners in New Brunswick/Trenton and surrounding Middlesex and Mercer County communities; also partners with local businesses (e.g. a taqueria).

size_signals.signal: Two branch offices (566 S Clinton Ave, Trenton and 195 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick) with separate phone, fax and email per branch
Site states 'more than 21 years of experience'; header says 'con más de 20 años de experiencia'
Sister businesses (Villanueva's Driving School, money transfer) and a partner/alliances section - inference: a multi-service group with several staff across two locations

listing.platform: Birdeye profile (claimed by the business; aggregates Google reviews - Google not viewed directly)

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Appointment-request form (WordPress WPForms, 32 fields) per branch - no calendar with real time slots
website_review.trust_signals: 21+ years, real office photos, Google-sourced client testimonials, partner logos, FAQ section, branch addresses and hours
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Broken image (missing flag icon) in the language switcher; half-translated English pages ('Address Line 2', 'varias consulados'); Spanish meta description served on /en/ pages; generic site title used on every page
website_review.search_basics: Titles repeat across pages ('Villanueva's Professional Services | Soluciones Integrales Para Usted') and name neither the town nor the service; no meta title per service; LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD exists but without hours or per-branch data; no robots.txt (404, unrestricted)
top_issues: No click-to-call anywhere - phone numbers are plain text on desktop and mobile, so a phone visitor must copy/paste the number to call the New Brunswick office.

Booking is a 32-field WPForms request form (with a US state dropdown and address block) rather than a short form plus calendar; no confirmation of a real time slot, so staff must call back to schedule.
English pages are half-translated, a header image is broken, titles/meta don't target 'tax preparation New Brunswick NJ', and hours are not in structured data.

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt returns 404 (no restrictions by default). LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD present with name, logo and address but no openingHours, service list or per-branch detail. Hours, services and FAQ answers are readable text. Booking is a form submission, not a calendar - an agent can request but not book, and there are no tel: links.

operations_signals.signal: Tax-season appointment requests arrive as a 32-field form with no calendar, so every request needs a manual callback - inference: one front-desk person absorbs scheduling for two branches.
Service list spans taxes, notary, translations, forms and money transfers - high walk-in volume with seven-day hours implied by the branch pages listing Sat hours.

All client photos and documents appear to be exchanged as WhatsApp images (uploads on the site are named 'WhatsApp-Image-...'), indicating WhatsApp is the real intake channel and nothing is tracked in a system.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the 32-field request form with a short bilingual intake plus a real scheduling calendar (or Booksy-style booking) for both branches, with SMS/WhatsApp confirmations and reminders.
top_opportunities.evidence: The New Brunswick appointment page is a 32-field WPForms with an address block and state dropdown, and no time-slot selection.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Spanish/English WhatsApp-first assistant that answers tax-season questions (documents needed, refund timing), books appointments and sends reminders - matching how this clientele already communicates.
top_opportunities.evidence: Site images are WhatsApp uploads, the audience is Spanish-speaking, and there is no chat or messaging widget on the site.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Localisation and local-SEO cleanup: proper English translations, town+service page titles, one page per service and per branch, hours in LocalBusiness schema, and mobile tel: links.
top_opportunities.evidence: Duplicate generic titles, Spanish meta description on the English site, broken flag image, no tel: links, no hours in schema.

scores.reasons: Heavy friction booking and no click-to-call on a five-star, high-volume two-branch tax office is a sizeable and easily evidenced gap; a small multi-service group has moderate budget and fixes are quick.
